changelogEntry.summary: Added the official Resident Evil account's August 4 two-million-wishlist milestone. A fresh review of Capcom, Steam, PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo still shows a 2027 release window with no exact release date; Steam PC requirements remain TBD, and no preorder timing, price, editions or demo are confirmed.
